say.en: A shareholder paid application money but ignored the allotment and call notices. The company can take back his shares and keep what he paid. That is forfeiture, and the company may later reissue those shares. In this lesson: Record forfeiture of shares issued at par and at premium.
Record reissue of forfeited shares.
Transfer the gain to Capital Reserve.

body.en: Share Capital A/c is debited with the amount called up on the forfeited shares; the unpaid calls are credited to the respective call accounts (or Calls in Arrears); the amount already received is credited to Share *Forfeiture* A/c. If the shares were issued at a premium and the premium has not been received, Securities Premium A/c is also debited; if the premium was received, it is not cancelled.
body.kn: ಮುಟ್ಟುಗೋಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕರೆದ ಮೊತ್ತಕ್ಕೆ ಷೇರು ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಖರ್ಚು, ಬಾಕಿ ಕರೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಜಮಾ, ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಿದ ಮೊತ್ತ ಷೇರು ಮುಟ್ಟುಗೋಲು ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಜಮಾ. ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂ ಬಂದಿಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ಸೆಕ್ಯುರಿಟೀಸ್ ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂ ಖಾತೆಗೂ ಖರ್ಚು.

steps.en: Forfeiture: Share Capital A/c Dr 1,000; To Share Allotment A/c 400; To Share First and Final Call A/c 300; To Share Forfeiture A/c 300.
Reissue: Bank A/c Dr 800; Share Forfeiture A/c Dr 200; To Share Capital A/c 1,000.
Balance in forfeiture on these shares = 300 − 200 = ₹100.
Share Forfeiture A/c Dr 100; To Capital Reserve A/c 100.

say.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. Ravi holds 100 shares of 10 rupees each (3 rupees application, 4 rupees allotment, 3 rupees call). He paid only the application money and his shares were forfeited after the call. They were reissued at 8 rupees per share fully paid. Pass the entries and find the capital reserve.
Forfeiture: Share Capital A over c Dr 1,000; To Share Allotment A over c 400; To Share First and Final Call A over c 300; To Share Forfeiture A over c 300.
Reissue: Bank A over c Dr 800; Share Forfeiture A over c Dr 200; To Share Capital A over c 1,000.
Balance in forfeiture on these shares equals 300 minus 200 equals 100 rupees.
Share Forfeiture A over c Dr 100; To Capital Reserve A over c 100.
So the answer is Capital reserve 100 rupees.

say.en: Now some questions in the pattern of the CUET UG Accountancy paper. 500 shares of 10 rupees each, on which 6 rupees per share had been paid, were forfeited. Of these, 300 shares were reissued at 8 rupees per share as fully paid. The amount transferred to Capital Reserve is.
Forfeited on the 300 reissued shares equals 300 times 6 equals 1,800 rupees.
Discount on reissue equals 300 times 2 equals 600 rupees.
Capital reserve equals 1,800 minus 600 equals 1,200 rupees.
